dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "37: For safety reasons, please do not carry any creatures with you incapable of flight."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "Note: In theory, humans are also a species without plumage who walk on two legs, and who are incapable of flight."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "Further Note: 'My friend has a wind glider — that totally counts as having flight capabilities' shall not be considered a valid excuse."
